narrative.overview: A parchment page ruled like a specimen sheet. A faint warm 12-column construction grid shows behind each Settings sheet, and every block (lighter cream paper) snaps to whole columns with shared 1px ink borders and equal row heights. Ink is a warm near-black on parchment, and a single terracotta marks what is active, primary or selected. Sage, amber and red-brown appear only to report state. One neutral grotesk carries every role. The parchment and terracotta palette is the user's and must not change. Built on Settings; other dashboard pages inherit only the shared tokens and have not been redesigned.
keyCharacteristics: 12-column grid with visible hairlines; blocks span whole columns.
Ink 1px borders separate blocks; soft rules separate rows inside a block.
Flat at rest: no shadows on page content.
One typeface, hierarchy by weight, size and tracked caps.
Terracotta means active/primary/selected only; state colors mean state only.

rules.name: The One Terracotta Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only accent: active tab, primary action, links and selection. Never use it for decoration, and never introduce a second accent.

rules.name: The State-Only Rule
rules.body: Sage, amber and red appear only where something reports status; each pairs with a label or dot, never color alone.

rules.name: The Palette Is Theirs Rule
rules.body: The parchment and terracotta palette is the user's decision; do not swap it for another.

rules.name: The Names-Small, Values-Large Rule
rules.body: Section names are small bold caps; the data they label is larger and plain. Names never compete with values.

rules.name: The Whole-Column Rule
rules.body: A block spans whole columns; no free-floating widths on a Sheet.

rules.name: The Flat-On-The-Page Rule
rules.body: Blocks on the page are ruled, never raised. Only floating layers get a shadow.

dos: Do build Settings content from Sheet, Cell, WideCell, SheetRow, SheetHeading, CellFoot so every edge lands on a column line.
Do separate blocks with ink 1px borders and rows with soft rules.
Do keep hints at 13px or larger and in muted ink; keep values larger than the names above them.
Do reserve terracotta for the active tab, primary action, links and selection.
Do use even spacing steps (4px unit).
Do use Segmented for short either/or choices.
donts: Don't add shadows to blocks or cards on the page.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a serif; the type is Red Hat Text only; the earlier Libre Baskerville and Montserrat faces are retired, the parchment and terracotta colors are kept.
Don't use terracotta or the state colors decoratively, or state color without a label.
Don't size blocks off the grid or let a row's blocks have unequal heights.
Don't treat the .dark token block as live; the dashboard is always light.
Don't assume other dashboard pages follow the Sheet system; they have not been redesigned.
Don't change the palette or reintroduce blue as an accent; the user rejected the blue version.
